title: Implement Kev adapter and coverage-ready resumable collection
description: Implements story BD-505817. Follow docs/kev-implementation-plan.md. Write failing offline specs, implement isolated Kev endpoint configuration and answer validation, add a generic resumable runner, then integrate offline scoring/reporting. No live inference in this implementation slice. Parent owns study registration and runtime coordination.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Lead review follow-up: resume identity must bind the full question.yaml (including scoring labels) and complete selected item records, not only id/text; add a failure-first regression for metadata-only and positive-class changes. CLI list/score must expose existing regulated cells. Leaderboard tests must remain valid once Kev is measured, while a controlled missing-Kev fixture verifies missing is never zero; glossary must reflect measured engine coverage. A second bounded Luna worker will make those compatibility fixes while the first adds frozen-study execution.

comments.text: Final compatibility review found a real incoming-coverage blocker: shared stereotypes question entries contain question and trope_consistent_answer but no trope field. Collector currently requires trope even though HTTP collection does not use it. Luna will add a failing regression using that exact schema, make only the unused trope field optional, and rerun targeted collector specs. Shared scorer/task import remains owned by coverage session; no stimuli changed.
